sn47.12:1.1: This was apparently the last time that the Buddha met Sāriputta. This encounter is recorded as part of the Mahāparinibbānasutta at [dn16:1.61.1]() and expanded into a long discourse at [dn28](). Here in the Saṁyutta, this meeting is followed with the record of Sāriputta’s passing at [sn47.13](), and then the lament for the absence of both Sāriputta and Moggallāna at [sn47.14 ](). For some reason these events were omitted from the Mahāparinibbānasutta, even though they fit well thematically.
